mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UPLOADED_FILE (ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, STORED_FILE_PATH, DOCUMENT_YEAR, INSTITUTION_NAME, INSTITUTION_CATEGORY, CLASSIFICATION_STATUS, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{year}, #{institutionName}, #{category}, #{status}, #{uploadedAt})

SELECT UPLOADED_FILE_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO UPLOADED_FILE (UPLOADED_FILE_ID, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, STORED_FILE_PATH, DOCUMENT_YEAR, INSTITUTION_NAME, INSTITUTION_CATEGORY, CLASSIFICATION_STATUS, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{year}, #{institutionName}, #{category}, #{status}, #{uploadedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET STORED_FILE_PATH = #{storedPath}, INSTITUTION_NAME = #{institutionName}, DOCUMENT_YEAR = #{year}, INSTITUTION_CATEGORY = #{category}, CLASSIFICATION_STATUS = #{status}, CLASSIFIED_AT = #{classifiedAt} WHERE UPLOADED_FILE_ID = #{id}
UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET CLASSIFICATION_STATUS = 'DELETED' WHERE UPLOADED_FILE_ID = #{id}
UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET CLASSIFICATION_STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE UPLOADED_FILE_ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME = '알수없음' AND CLASSIFICATION_STATUS = 'CLASSIFIED' ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE CLASSIFICATION_STATUS = #{status}
SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE (#{institution} = '' OR INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{institution}, '%')) AND (#{year} = '' OR DOCUMENT_YEAR = #{year}) AND (#{keyword} = '' OR ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE (#{institution} IS NULL OR INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{institution} || '%') AND (#{year} IS NULL OR DOCUMENT_YEAR = #{year}) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC
